documentNotes.title: Notes for the Local FWE-team:
documentNotes.statement:
The following resources must be provided in the Resource Booklet for the problem solving test:

1. General information about Wanjing district - residential population, landuse, energy use, water consumption, transport systems and routes, sustainable community features etc.

2. A clear well-labelled map showing the neighbourhood around Huayandongqu Community and the empty plot of land next to it. The North arrow as well as scale of the map needs to be clear to aid students in developing their answers.

3. A clear well-labelled map showing the landuse of the neighbourhood around the the Beixiaohe River, the north arrow as well as scale of the map needs to be clear to aid students in developing their answers.

4. Information about the Elevated Transit Bus system.

The following resources must be provided for students to complete their tasks:

- Sketch map (Fig. 1) of the Beixiaohe River?Canal for annotation.

transcription.notes: The masthead prints only "FWExercise Part 2 – Test Booklet" (no competition, year or venue); the catalogue metadata (iGeo 2016, fieldwork exercise) is kept. Three tasks, five printed sub-items (Task 1 i)–ii), Task 2 i)–ii), Task 3 i)); no marks and no time limit are printed. The solutions document in the archive (2016FW1marking.pdf) is headed "Field Work Exercise 1 – Part 1" and marks different, observation tasks (annotating Fig. 1–3, Table 1 water quality, Table 2 traffic count) with 12, 9 and 11 marks; it is not the marking scheme of this Part 2 test, so no solution or answer is attached. Page 2 (Notes for the Local FWE-team) is kept as a document note. Kept verbatim: "Wanjing" beside "Wangjing" (a name), the doubled "the the Beixiaohe River" and "River?Canal" in the notes on page 2. The underlined word "must" on page 2 is in the team notes, not in a task. The sketch map (Fig. 1) and the resource booklet are not in this file, so there are no figures.

problems.title: Sustainability and liveability – Wangjing Huayandongqu Community
problems.statement: Using the materials in the resource booklet as well as your observations yesterday, design a sustainable residential development for the empty plot of land next to the Wangjing Huayandongqu Community,

parts.label: i)
parts.statement: represent your proposed development using annotated sketches/ maps;

parts.label: ii)
parts.statement: explain how your proposed development will enhance the sustainability and liveability of the area and for the local community in 400 words or less.

solution.incompleteReason: The archive holds no marking scheme for this Part 2 task; the solutions file filed with this paper is the marking scheme of Field Work Exercise 1 – Part 1.

problems.title: Water management – Beixiaohe River
problems.statement: Based on your observations of the Beixiaohe River yesterday, the changes you might make to the canal to:

parts.label: i)
parts.statement: improve water retention during the dry seasons;

parts.label: ii)
parts.statement: enhance the liveability of the area for the local community.

problems.statementAfterParts:
Annotate your suggestions on the sketch map provided (Fig. 1).
No additional text or writing is permitted beyond the annotated sketch.

problems.title: Traffic junction and subway station
problems.statement: With reference to the resource materials on the Transit Elevated Bus provided, and based on your field observations yesterday:

parts.label: i)
parts.statement: analyse the strengths and weaknesses of the proposed Transit Elevated Bus system in addressing sustainability and liveability issues observed in Wanjing in 400 words or less.
